name: Cost Optimizer
tagline: Finds the less expensive route to the same result across your agent stack
description: Point it at the automation you already pay for and it goes over the bill piece by piece, setting your routines against your one-off bots, and your cloud-side agents against plain scripted actions. Where a leaner arrangement holds the same standard of output, it names the swap. It adds nothing to that bill.
author: MadeItHappenX
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
